name: AIZO
recent: AIZO Group Berhad 在2026年11月24日举行第24届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。公司于11月26日发布2027财年第一季度业绩，营收同比增长6%至3597万令吉，土木工程业务营收增长18%。此外，公司于11月24日宣布子公司签署SSA，以100万RGT收购Netrunner 100%股权。
notable: 子公司签署SSA，以100万RGT收购Netrunner 100%股权。
2027财年第一季度营收同比增长6%至3597万令吉，土木工程营收增长18%。
第24届常年股东大会所有决议获股东通过。
risks: 独立非执行董事Lo Ling在闭锁期內于11月4日出售16,297,200股普通股，占0.733%。
公司发行79,713,321股新股，来自不可赎回可转换优先股（ICPS）到期自动转换，可能造成股权摊薄。
公司于2026年6月30日止季度录得净亏损578万令吉，净利率为-14.9%。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为3881万令吉，环比增长11.4%，同比增长4.8%；净亏损578万令吉，净利率为-14.9%，较上季度的-2.1%扩大。

recent_en: AIZO Group Berhad held its 24th Annual General Meeting on 24 November 2026, with all resolutions passed. On 26 November, the company reported Q1 FY2027 results with revenue up 6% year-on-year to RM35.97 million, driven by an 18% increase in civil engineering revenue. On 24 November, its subsidiary entered into an SSA to acquire 100% of Netrunner for 1 million RGT.
notable_en: Subsidiary entered into an SSA to acquire 100% of Netrunner for 1 million RGT.
Q1 FY2027 revenue rose 6% year-on-year to RM35.97 million, with civil engineering revenue up 18%.
All resolutions at the 24th AGM were passed by shareholders.
risks_en: Independent Non-Executive Director Lo Ling disposed of 16,297,200 ordinary shares (0.733%) on 4 November during the closed period.
The company issued 79,713,321 new shares from the mandatory automatic conversion of irredeemable convertible preference shares (ICPS) upon maturity, which may dilute shareholding.
The company recorded a net loss of RM5.78 million for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, with a net margin of -14.9%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM38.81 million, up 11.4% QoQ and 4.8% YoY; net loss was RM5.78 million with a net margin of -14.9%, widening from -2.1% in the previous quarter.
